description: Get ready to unwind at Blue Sand Retreat!Whether it's a quick trip or a long stay, we have everything you need for a perfect vacation: full air conditioning, comfy queen-sized beds, fully-equipped kitchen, large TV, beach gear, washer/dryer and private plunge pool. All this with a central location moments from downtown Rincon (2 min), Lala's (4 min) & all our local beaches! We also have backup solar power and reliable wifi. Working remote? Let us know so we can set you up for success.The spaceThe Blue Sand Retreat is on the ground floor of a quiet 3 unit, concrete home. The space has its own private entrance facing the street with parking reserved right out the door, ideal for unpacking the car! There's also plenty of room to store surf boards on your front porch or have a drink and relax. The front yard also offers a picnic table in front of the propane/charcoal BBQ.The kitchen is fully stocked to make your favorite meals and seats 6. Both bathrooms have very hot water and rain-style showerheads.The washer/dryer is stocked with detergent. Off the Master bedroom, you have access to your own private "secret garden" with two small sitting areas for your morning coffee or evening glass of wine. The backyard also has a plunge pool under the string lights so you have some private water space just for you.Other things to noteWe are in walking distance to town, but driving is still generally recommended for safety and to be able to get the most out of all Rincon has to offer.

title: Villa Gloria - Glorious Views #1
description: Immerse yourself in traditional Caribbean tropical luxury at this unique and tranquil getaway. Enjoy breathtaking vistas of the sea and mountains from your own private balcony. Walk 5 mins. to Rincón’s #1 brunch, or take our gear down the hill for exceptional snorkeling. Close to everything, but away from it all. We have thought of every detail and will assure your stay is unforgettable. We have full auto backup power so no worries ever. Sorry no pets/service animals due to allergies/asthma.The spaceVilla Gloria is a private home atop two picturesque acres with breathtaking views of the Caribbean Sea and the mountains of Puerto Rico. We are at one of the highest points in Rincón Pueblo, while also very close to the best beaches, surfing and restaurants/bars. The property is incredibly peaceful and teaming with nature. The apartment has its own private parking and entrance, along with a private balcony. The space is your own and you can take comfort knowing it is safe, private and quiet.Other things to noteWe can arrange the bedroom with twin beds or a king bed. We understand there may be a preference either way. Let us know and we’ll make sure the room is just the way you like it.

title: Beachfront Modern Apt | Direct Sand Access
description: Welcome to Villa Sanfe, your serene beachfront escape — a tranquil apartment steps from the sand. Nestled directly on the shoreline, this peaceful retreat offers uninterrupted views of the ocean, soft sea breezes, and the soothing sound of waves. Inside, relax in a light-filled space with coastal décor, a cozy seating area, and a full kitchen. Step out to the balcony and feel instantly connected to nature. Perfect for peaceful getaways or family friendly escapes. Your beachside haven awaits.The spaceA beautifully remodeled oceanfront, ground floor apartment designed in a modern boho coastal style that blends clean lines, relaxed textures, and tropical touches. From the natural finishes to the breezy open spaces, every detail is curated to make you feel at ease from the moment you arrive.Two spacious bedrooms provide privacy and restful sleep, each with easy access to two full bathrooms for added comfort and convenience. The master bedroom includes a plush king bed plus a convenient twin bunk bed, ideal for kids or extra guests. The second bedroom offers a stylish daybed with two twin mattresses that can be set up as separate beds or pushed together to create a split king, depending on your group’s needs.In the living room, you'll find a sofa bed for added sleeping space without sacrificing comfort.The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need to prepare meals at home, complemented by a dedicated dining area ideal for enjoying fresh coffee or sunset dinners.Unwind in the inviting living room, complete with cozy seating and large windows that flood the space with natural light and ocean breezes.Step out onto your spacious private balcony overlooking the ocean—the highlight of the home—perfect for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or simply taking in the breathtaking views and soothing sounds of the waves.The apartment is fully air conditioned and has direct access to Los Almendros Beach. The apartment also offers one assigned parking space within the secure gated parking area.To maintain the quality and cleanliness of our space, the laundry closet is reserved for host use only and is not available to guests. If you need laundry facilities during your stay, we’re happy to recommend nearby options.Guest accessGuests will have exclusive access to the apartment, including:- Private oceanfront balcony with direct beach access (no stairs required!)- 2 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms-Living room and dining area-Fully equipped kitchen-Free on-site parkingGuests will also have access to 2 beach chairs, a cooler, and beach towels (one per guest)—perfect for a day on the sand just steps from your door.Other things to noteLike many areas in Puerto Rico, occasional power outages may occur due to weather or infrastructure limitations. We kindly ask for your patience and understanding in these circumstances, which are unfortunately outside of our control. While most outages are brief, to help you stay comfortable, we provide battery-powered lanterns and a battery-operated fan.

description: This relaxing and tranquil space is perfect for the single adventure traveler or a couple looking for time to retreat and rewind. Located in a quiet local neighborhood just 3 doors from the water and 2 minutes to amazing swimming beaches. Unit #1 is a one bedroom with AC in the master and a full kitchen with open living space and high speed WiFi. Amazing covered back patio which includes a wet bar, hammock chairs and multiple relaxation zones. Opportunity to rent all 3 units for full privacy.The spaceThe space is perfect for the single adventure traveler or a couple. It has its own private entrance as well as a door to the communal back patio and bar area. The unit is a full 1 bedroom with an open concept living/kitchen area with a breakfast bar, as well as a bathroom and spacious bedroom with queen size bed. Amenities include a refrigerator, apartment size gas stove, coffee maker, toaster, microwave, dishes, pots and pans, utensils, cutlery, bath towels, beach towels. The shower has an on-demand water heater which is common to Puerto Rico.We are located on quiet local street that dead ends into the ocean just 3 houses down. Easy to find (this address actually pulls up on your phone!), your vacation will begin stress free. Utilities include reliable town water (plus a 400 gallon cistern), full electricity, on demand hot water direct to the shower, AC in the bedroom, ceiling fans in the living room and bedroom, and high speed WiFi, you can unplug or plug in as much as you desire. The amazing back patio features hammocks, bamboo bar, outdoor dining and plenty of space to relax as well as a both a BBQ and charcoal grill. This apartment is 1 of 3 units in our freestanding complex. Because of this you will be sharing parking and the communal patio with other guests. This is a great opportunity to meet and socialize with guests from around the world. We think it's the best combination of a hostel meets hotel situation. Plenty of privacy with the opportunity to be social if you would like. Rincon attracts visitors from Puerto Rico, Europe, Latin America and across the United States. Our guests are usually laid back, adventurous and friendly travelers and we only ask that everyone be respectful of the quiet hours and the maintenance of the community areas.// Please be aware that across the island our utility systems are fragile. Our neighborhood has a reputation for having very consistent power and water, however occasional outages are beyond our control. We do have a 400 gallon backup water cistern available for guests. At this time we do not have a back-up generator. However, we do supply flashlights and battery lights for our guests.Guest accessKeyless entry makes arrival and entry very convenient.Other things to noteThis is a relaxed, family neighborhood. If you are looking to relax and unwind, this is the place for you. If you are looking to party late into the night, this is not the best spot. We ask that you wind down the noise at 10pm as to not disturb our wonderful neighbors.

description: Relaxed hillside stay in Rincón — perfect for groups seeking shared time and their own space, just minutes from beaches and town.Located in Pineapple Hill, enjoy 2 private apartments w/ connected balcony, ocean peeks, fast WiFi (600 Mbps), A/C in all bedrooms, & a calm setting 5–10 minutes from everything.Includes 4 bedrooms, 2 showers, & 4 toilets. Steps Beach is reachable via a scenic ~30-minute hike (moderate to difficult). Includes street parking.The spaceThis apartment displays some accessibility features such as direct access from the street (no stairs). Entrance and doors that measure over 32 inches wide. Bathroom doors measure 28 inches wide.Guest accessSelf check-in via lockbox. You will have full access to your units and the shared laundry room. The downstairs patio area is currently restricted.Other things to noteDetails to note before your stay at Casa Ramé:• Hot Showers 🚿Showers are equipped with on-demand heaters for your comfort. Bathroom and kitchen sinks run on cool water, a common feature in Puerto Rico. Please note that hot water is unavailable during power outages.• Electricity ⚡Casa Ramé does not have a generator. While outages are occasional and typically brief, they offer a gentle invitation to slow down and enjoy the natural rhythm of island life.• Septic System 🚽Our home uses a sensitive septic system. We kindly ask that only human waste be flushed. A bin is provided for all other items, as is customary in many island homes.• Shared Balcony 👣The balcony serves as a shared walkway to the laundry area and staff room. You may occasionally see others passing through, though your apartment remains fully private.• Laundry Access 🧺A shared washer and dryer are available on-site during designated hours. Guests are welcome to bring their preferred detergent.• Extended Stays 🗓️Longer stays may be available upon request.
